description: Authentic Dungeons & Dragons tabletop engine, autonomous AI adventuring party, and modular quest modules for terminal agents

skills.name: classic-dnd-dungeon-master
skills.description: Compels the AI agent to act as a 1980s Old-School Dungeons & Dragons Dungeon Master (AD&D 1e/2e style). Features ASCII roguelike dungeon maps, d20 dice checks with THAC0, saving throws against segmentation faults, and converts coding tasks into tabletop dungeon crawls.
skills.author: c4da

skills.name: dnd-party-of-agents
skills.description: Spawns a full 4-member tabletop D&D adventuring party (Paladin, Barbarian, Rogue, Wizard) in your terminal. When your real-life friends cancel game night again, play D&D with autonomous AI agents who banter, argue over architecture, roll d20 dice, and tackle coding quests together.
skills.author: c4da

skills.name: dnd-quest-the-lost-shrine
skills.description: A complete, ready-to-run D&D starter adventure module ("The Lost Shrine of the Sun-Stone"). Plugs into classic-dnd-dungeon-master or dnd-party-of-agents to showcase all core tabletop mechanics—stealth, perception, trap disarming, riddles, tactical turn-based boss combat, and loot.
skills.author: c4da
